children: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) enters a leadership and product pivot as Tim Cook becomes executive chairman with John Ternus as CEO Sept 1 while rolling out M6 Macs, Apple Intelligence with agentic Siri, a potential foldable iPhone, multiple H2 device launches, new pricing, leasing via Klarna, and regulatory headwinds denting App Store revenue.
Previous Week Recap
Tim Cook Executive Chairman, John Ternus CEO
: Apple (AAPL) announced CEO change: Tim Cook becomes executive chairman and John Ternus named CEO effective Sept 1. Cook will assist transition while Ternus leads company operations.
Mac Mini M6 2nm, M5 Pro; Mac Studio M5 Max/Ultra
: AAPL updated desktops: Mac mini adds M6 (2nm) from $899 and M5 Pro from $1,699; Mac Studio offers M5 Max and M5 Ultra up to 512GB memory. Preorders Aug 25/now; deliveries Sept 22.
Apple Intelligence With Siri, Gemini
: Apple to roll out “Apple Intelligence” with agentic Siri, powered partly by Google Gemini and Apple’s foundation models, for deployment across Apple devices after prior delays.
Apple Foldable iPhone, Premium Pricing
: Apple (AAPL) plans a foldable iPhone; traders note potential premium pricing, margin upside, launch timing with Pro refresh and wearables, and demand/availability as key trading drivers.
H2 Apple Watch, AirPods 5, OLED iPad mini
: Apple (AAPL) to launch multiple products H2: new Apple Watch models, AirPods 5, smart home display, Apple TV set-top, HomePod mini, OLED iPad mini (late Oct) and M6 iMac and entry MacBook Pro
California Rulings Cut App Store Revenue
: California rulings let developers route payments to their sites, driving about a 6% drop in US App Store commission revenue for Apple (AAPL) in the June quarter.
Streaming Price Hikes: Apple TV+, Apple One
: AAPL raised U.S. streaming prices: Apple TV+ monthly to $14.99 (from $12.99), annual to $119 (from $99), and Apple One monthly to $21.95. Changes apply after customer notice.
Japan Complaint On App Distribution
: Apple (AAPL) faces a Japan complaint alleging it still limits alternative app distribution; developers say 90% avoid new third‑party stores due to fees and complex installation.
Apple Upgrade Leasing With Klarna
: Apple (AAPL) launches leasing-style Apple Upgrade with Klarna to finance iPhone, Watch, Mac and iPad; offers upgrade, keep or return at lease end while Klarna handles payments and credit risk.
Stock Rises Ahead Of Sept Event
: AAPL rose ~1.5% before Apple’s Sept. 9 product event. Shares are up ~37% year‑over‑year and ~17% since John Ternus promotion. Traders await new devices, including a possible foldable.
